_about: What each model family runs on, per kind of hardware. tools/capability_table.py builds docs/CAPABILITIES.md and the short summaries in AI_SETUP, AI_REFERENCE and MEDIA_KIT from this file and from the release's package names (docs/data/release.json). 'Packaged' is never typed here: it is read from the asset list. 'supported' is what the docs commit to: yes, untested (a package exists, nothing is claimed), or no. 'measured' names where numbers are published; an empty field means none are published, not that it fails.

nvidia_win.limits: The package carries RTX 40 code (sm_89); we have not run an RTX 40 card.

nvidia_linux.limits: The package carries RTX 40 code (sm_89); we have not run an RTX 40 card.

amd_win.hardware: Ryzen AI Max / Strix Halo, gfx1151
amd_win.limits: The package is built for gfx1151. Other AMD cards on Windows: nothing is claimed.

amd_linux.limits: The RX 9070 (gfx1200) uses the same package and is untested. Ryzen AI Max (Strix Halo) on Linux has no DeepSeek package.

intel_linux.limits: No package. DeepSeek does not run on Intel ([INTEL.md](INTEL.md)).

mac.hardware: 64 GB or more, macOS 15 or newer
mac.limits: Text; pictures only with an engine that carries the Metal picture reader (marker STRATA_DS4_METAL_VISION_V1, present in the 0.1.58 package). Nothing under 128 GB was run.

amd_linux.hardware: RX 6000, 7000 and 9000, Radeon AI PRO R9700, Ryzen AI Max
amd_linux.limits: RX 6000 is validated differently from the newer cards ([AMD_HIP.md](AMD_HIP.md)).

intel_linux.limits: Linux only (Ubuntu 24.04 or newer); the model is prepared for the card first, with per-card limits ([INTEL_ARC.md](INTEL_ARC.md)).

mac.hardware: M1 or newer, macOS 15 or newer

nvidia_spark.limits: The engine package is the same one; no page states a Qwen3.6 run on the Spark.

intel_linux.limits: The Intel Arc engine does not run this family ([QWEN36.md](QWEN36.md)).

mac.limits: The Mac engine does not run this family ([QWEN36.md](QWEN36.md)).
